edge.description: Attaches a device interface handle to a switch hub. Reference targets are validated by the server, not by this schema.

sourceHandleId.description: Handle of the source node, when it is a device.

targetHandleId.description: Handle of the target node, when it is a device.

iconKey.description: Builder local icon hint; empty selects the default icon.

identifier.description: Stable RFC 4122 UUID. Identifiers are compared case-insensitively; the front end mints new identifiers with crypto.randomUUID.

interfaceHandle.description: Stable mapping of a canvas handle onto a named interface of the device spec.

alias.description: Optional integer VLAN alias published to an experiment.

node.description: Canvas node. The payload key must match the node kind.

parentId.description: Identifier of the group node this node belongs to.
